title: Get to Know Me Questions: 110 Fun Tag Questions to Answer
h1: Get to Know Me Questions: 110 Fun Tag Questions for Videos, Posts and Real Life
description: 110 get to know me questions for YouTube tags, TikTok, Instagram stories, icebreakers and new friendships, grouped from easy and silly to personal and deep.
excerpt: 110 get to know me questions sorted from quick and silly to thoughtful and personal, perfect for tag videos, stories, icebreakers and new relationships.
intro:
A good set of get to know me questions does two jobs at once. It gives people an easy way into who you are, and it nudges you to think about things you rarely say out loud: the smell that takes you straight back to childhood, the habit you’re secretly proud of, the dream you haven’t told many people.

Whether you’re filming a “get to know me” tag, filling out an Instagram story template, breaking the ice in a new group, or swapping answers with someone you’re dating, the 110 questions below have you covered. They start light and get gradually more personal, so you can stop wherever feels right.
body:
How to use these get to know me questions

These questions work for a few different settings, and each one calls for a slightly different approach:

  • Tag videos and posts: Pick 15 to 25 questions from different sections so your answers show range. Mix a few silly ones with one or two that reveal something real.
  • Story templates: Short, snappy questions from the “quick-fire” and “favorites” sections work best, since people tap through fast.
  • Icebreakers and new friends: Take turns answering the same question. Hearing each other’s answers is where the connection happens.
  • Dating: Save the deeper sections for once you’re comfortable. For more date-specific prompts, see our first date questions.
Tip: You never owe anyone an answer. If you’re posting publicly, skip anything that would reveal your address, school, workplace or daily routine.

Quick-fire get to know me questions

Fast, low-stakes and fun to rattle off on camera.

  1. Morning person or night owl?
  2. Coffee, tea, or neither?
  3. Sweet or salty snacks?
  4. Beach vacation or mountain cabin?
  5. Texting or calling?
  6. Cats, dogs, or both?
  7. Books or movies?
  8. Summer or winter?
  9. Early to everything or fashionably late?
  10. Messy room or spotless room?
  11. Pizza or tacos?
  12. Window seat or aisle seat?
  13. Sunrise or sunset?
  14. Spontaneous plans or planned in advance?
  15. Hoodies or jackets?
  16. Ice cream in a cone or a cup?

Favorites: the classic tag questions

  1. What’s your favorite movie you could rewatch forever?
  2. What’s your favorite comfort food?
  3. Which song do you have on repeat right now?
  4. What’s your favorite season, and why?
  5. What’s your favorite word?
  6. What’s the best book you’ve read in the last year?
  7. What’s your favorite smell?
  8. Which TV show could you talk about for hours?
  9. What’s your favorite holiday tradition?
  10. What’s your go-to order at a coffee shop?
  11. What’s your favorite way to spend a rainy day?
  12. Which app do you open the most?
  13. What’s your favorite thing to cook or bake?
  14. What’s your favorite place you’ve ever visited?
  15. Which color shows up the most in your wardrobe?
  16. What’s your favorite memory from this year so far?

Fun and silly get to know me questions

  1. What’s the weirdest food combination you secretly love?
  2. If you were a kitchen appliance, which one would you be?
  3. What’s the most useless talent you have?
  4. What would your wrestling or stage name be?
  5. Which fictional character do people say you remind them of?
  6. What’s the funniest thing that’s happened to you this month?
  7. If animals could talk, which one would be the rudest?
  8. What’s a hill you are willing to die on?
  9. What would you name a pet goldfish?
  10. What’s the strangest dream you remember?
  11. Which song would play when you walk into a room?
  12. What’s an emoji you use way too much?
  13. What’s a trend you never understood?
  14. If you had to eat one meal for the rest of your life, what would it be?
  15. What’s the most embarrassing song on your playlist?
  16. If you could only speak in movie quotes for a day, which movie would you pick?

Personal life questions

A little more about where you come from and how you live.

  1. Where did you grow up, and what was it like?
  2. Do you have siblings? Where do you fall in the birth order?
  3. What did you want to be when you were little?
  4. What does a typical weekend look like for you?
  5. What’s one tradition from your family you want to keep?
  6. Who has been the biggest influence on your life?
  7. What’s a skill you taught yourself?
  8. What hobby could you talk about for an hour?
  9. What’s something that always cheers you up?
  10. What does your perfect day look like from start to finish?
  11. What’s something you’re currently learning?
  12. Who do you text first when something good happens?
  13. What’s your favorite thing about where you live now?
  14. What part of your daily routine do you look forward to most?
  15. How do you recharge after a long week?
  16. What’s a small luxury you refuse to give up?

Interesting “would you rather” and hypothetical questions

  1. Would you rather be able to fly or be invisible?
  2. If you could live in any time period, which would you choose?
  3. If you won the lottery tomorrow, what’s the first thing you’d do?
  4. Would you rather know every language or play every instrument?
  5. If you could have dinner with anyone, living or not, who would it be?
  6. If you could instantly master one skill, what would it be?
  7. Would you rather live in a big city or the countryside?
  8. If you could swap lives with someone for a day, who would it be?
  9. Would you rather explore space or the deep ocean?
  10. If your life were a movie, what genre would it be?
  11. If you could relive one day, which one would you pick?
  12. Would you rather have a rewind button or a pause button for your life?
  13. If you could move anywhere in the world tomorrow, where would you go?
  14. If you opened a small business, what would it sell?
  15. Would you rather always be ten minutes early or always be ten minutes late?
  16. If you could have any animal as a pet, with no rules, what would you pick?
  17. Would you rather give up music or give up movies?
  18. If you could be famous for one thing, what would you want it to be?

Deeper get to know me questions

These are the ones that make people stop scrolling. Answer them only if you’re comfortable.

  1. What’s something you believe now that you didn’t believe five years ago?
  2. What are you most proud of?
  3. What’s a fear you’ve overcome?
  4. What’s the best advice you’ve ever been given?
  5. When do you feel most like yourself?
  6. What’s something people often get wrong about you?
  7. What does friendship mean to you?
  8. What’s a goal you’re quietly working toward?
  9. What makes you feel loved?
  10. What’s a lesson you learned the hard way?
  11. What do you want to be remembered for?
  12. What’s a habit you’d like to break?
  13. Which moment changed the direction of your life?
  14. What are three words your closest friends would use to describe you?
  15. What do you value most in other people?
  16. What would you tell your younger self?

Get to know me questions for couples and crushes

Swap answers with a partner or someone you’re talking to. For more, try our deep questions to ask your boyfriend or would you rather questions for couples.

  1. What’s your idea of a perfect date?
  2. How do you like to be comforted when you’re upset?
  3. What’s your love language, if you had to pick one?
  4. What’s the most romantic thing anyone has done for you?
  5. What’s a small gesture that means a lot to you?
  6. What’s your favorite way to spend a lazy Sunday together?
  7. What’s something on your bucket list we could do together?
  8. What song reminds you of being in love?
  9. Do you prefer big celebrations or quiet ones?
  10. What made you first notice me?
  11. What’s a dealbreaker for you in a relationship?
  12. What’s one thing you want me to know about you that I might not have guessed?

Making your get to know me video or post stand out

Plenty of people answer the same questions, so the difference is in how you answer. A few ideas:

  • Tell a mini story. Instead of “My favorite food is ramen,” mention the tiny shop where you first tried it.
  • Show, don’t just tell. Hold up your favorite book, play ten seconds of the song, show your cluttered desk.
  • Let your personality lead. Laugh at your own weird answers. Viewers connect with authenticity far more than polish.
  • Invite replies. End by asking viewers to answer one question in the comments. It turns a monologue into a conversation.

Using these questions to build real connection

Offline, the magic isn’t in the question but in the follow-up. When someone answers, ask “why?” or “what was that like?” and then really listen. You’ll learn more in one honest exchange than in fifty rapid-fire answers.

If you’re trying to grow your social circle, these questions pair nicely with our guide on how to make friends as an adult. And if you’ve got a game night coming up, browse the rest of our question lists.
takeaways: Mix quick, silly questions with a few deeper ones so your answers show real range.
For public videos or posts, skip anything that reveals your location, school or routine.
Little stories and specific details make ordinary answers memorable.
In person, the follow-up question matters more than the first one.

faq.q: What are good get to know me questions?
faq.a: Good ones are easy to answer but still reveal personality, such as your perfect day, a hill you’d die on, the best advice you’ve received, or what makes you feel most like yourself. A mix of quick favorites, silly hypotheticals and a few deeper questions gives the most complete picture.

faq.q: How many questions should a get to know me tag have?
faq.a: For a video, 15 to 25 questions usually keeps things moving without dragging. Story templates work best with 5 to 10 short questions. If you’re playing in person, there’s no limit; just keep going as long as the conversation feels fun for everyone.

faq.q: What should I not share in a get to know me post?
faq.a: Avoid anything that could help a stranger find or impersonate you: your full address, school, workplace, daily schedule, pet names used in passwords, or security-question answers like your first car or mother’s maiden name. Keep personal answers about personality and opinions, not identifying details.

faq.q: Can couples use get to know me questions?
faq.a: Absolutely. Even long-term partners learn new things from questions about childhood memories, hopes and small preferences. Take turns answering, ask follow-up questions, and treat it as a relaxed date-night activity rather than a quiz.
